claim: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (JFE 2018): on SPY, the first half-hour return predicts the last half-hour return; out-of-sample R2 about 0.018 and a timing rule earned 6.3% vs -0.5% per year gross (1999-2012).

evidence.quote: the first half-hour return on the market as measured from the previous day’s market close predicts the last half-hour return.
SPY first half-hour returns predict last half-hour returns with R-squared 0.018 out-of-sample, generating 6.3% vs -0.5% gross annual return
evidence.source_title: CXO Advisory: First and Last Half-Hours of Trading Linked

claim: Zarattini & Aziz 5-minute opening-range breakout on QQQ: 33.2% CAGR vs 14.9% buy-and-hold, Jan 2016-Feb 2023, with zero slippage and up to 4x leverage, in-sample.

evidence.quote: outperformed buy-and-hold QQQ (33.2% vs 14.9% CAGR; Jan 2016–Feb 2023; 1,795 trades; zero slippage assumed)
evidence.source_title: CXO Advisory: Day Trading with an Opening Range Breakout Strategy (summary of SSRN 4416622)

claim: An independent replication of the 5-minute ORB on index CFDs (2015-2026) reproduces the gross edge (about +0.13 R per trade) but net of costs it is about zero on Nasdaq (+0.002 R) and negative in 4 of 5 markets.

evidence.quote: Gross yes: +0.131 R on NQ, as in the paper. Net no: no market is distinguishable from zero, four of five are negative.
evidence.source_title: The opening-range breakout paper, replicated on five indices: gross reproduced, net zero (MQL5 blog)

evidence.quote: the out-of-sample years 2021 to 2026 give +0.06 R on NQ at best.
evidence.source_title: The opening-range breakout paper, replicated on five indices: gross reproduced, net zero (MQL5 blog)

claim: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon SPY 'noise area' intraday momentum (2007-early 2024): 19.6% annualised net of costs, Sharpe 1.33, flat at close.

evidence.quote: From 2007 to early 2024, the resulting intraday momentum portfolio achieved a total return of 1,985% (net of costs), an annualized return of 19.6%, and a Sharpe Ratio of 1.33.
evidence.source_title: Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY) (SFI RP 24-97)

claim: SPY overnight gap and the same day's open-to-close return have a correlation of about 0.01 (1993-2025), so neither gap fade nor gap continuation works on average.

evidence.quote: SPY opening gaps showed little tendency toward reversal or continuation of the gap through the rest of the trading day (correlation 0.01 between gap and open-to-close return; Jan 1993–Mar 2025
evidence.source_title: CXO Advisory: Gap Reversal or Continuation?
